items.quote: the servant of his house, that ruled over all that he had
items.claim: Abraham's household servant had authority over all his possessions

items.quote: And I will make thee swear by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth
items.claim: Abraham will require the servant to swear an oath before God
items.mechanism: by the LORD, the God of heaven, and the God of the earth

items.quote: thou shalt not take a wife unto my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I dwell
items.claim: The servant shall not marry a wife from the Canaanites for Isaac
items.object: a wife of the daughters of the Canaanites

items.quote: But thou shalt go unto my country, and to my kindred, and take a wife unto my son Isaac
items.claim: The servant shall travel to Abraham's homeland and kinfolk to obtain a wife for Isaac
items.object: a wife unto my son Isaac
